guide.text: Increases Cyborg's HP and boosts nearby allies' Attack, reinforcing his role as a team-wide physical damage booster.

Increases HP and provides an Attack bonus to nearby allies. The Flash's Ultimate channels his Energy to an ally and increases their Attack, and with Robot Duplicate's Attack bonus, that ally benefits from double Attack bonuses.
Increases HP and grants an Attack bonus to nearby allies. Zatanna's Ultimate boosts all allies' Attack, and with Robot Duplicate's Attack bonus, allies benefit from higher bonus Attack.

Increases HP and grants an Attack bonus to nearby allies. Vixen is a Supporter who focuses on increasing allies' Attack, and with Robot Duplicate's Attack bonus, allies benefit from multiple Attack bonuses.
Provides Energy gain and base attribute bonuses, helping The Flash cast his Ultimate more often and keep allies fueled with Energy and damage boosts.
